attributes.name: right_arm_only
attributes.text: Only the right arm moves while the left arm stays still.
attributes.definition: The right arm and hand carry the motion; the left arm hangs or rests without a matching movement, and the legs do not take part.

attributes.name: both_arms_mirror
attributes.text: Both arms move together as mirror images.
attributes.definition: Left and right arms make the same movement at the same time on opposite sides of the body.

attributes.name: one_hand_holds_other_works
attributes.text: One hand stays still while the other hand works near it.
attributes.definition: Both hands are close together in front of the body; one (usually the left) stays nearly fixed while the other makes the repeated or larger movement.

attributes.name: arms_alternate_sides
attributes.text: One arm acts, then the other arm repeats the action on its side.
attributes.definition: The two arms make similar movements one after the other rather than at the same time.

attributes.name: torso_carries_motion
attributes.text: The torso bends or twists as a main part of the movement.
attributes.definition: The spine joints change angle or rotate clearly relative to the hips, not just following the arms.

attributes.name: one_leg_active
attributes.text: One leg makes the main movement while the other supports.
attributes.definition: A single leg lifts, swings or stamps while the other leg holds the body weight.

attributes.name: legs_alternate
attributes.text: The two legs move in alternation, one after the other.
attributes.definition: Left and right legs take turns lifting and supporting, as in stepping or running.

attributes.name: both_legs_flex_together
attributes.text: Both knees bend or straighten at the same time.
attributes.definition: Both legs flex or extend simultaneously, raising or lowering the hips, with both feet staying on the same footing.

attributes.name: wrist_and_hand_dominant
attributes.text: Small motions of the wrist and hand, with the arm nearly still.
attributes.definition: Movement is concentrated at the hand and hand tip joints; the elbow and shoulder change little.

attributes.name: forearm_swings_upper_arm_still
attributes.text: The forearm swings at the elbow while the upper arm stays still.
attributes.definition: The elbow joint stays roughly fixed and the forearm and hand move back and forth around it.

attributes.name: whole_arm_from_shoulder
attributes.text: The whole straight arm moves widely from the shoulder.
attributes.definition: The arm moves as a long lever about the shoulder, so the hand travels a large distance with the elbow mostly straight.
